changes.reason: Checks exact-blob applicability in the required Formal validation job on every change. For release tags and manual runs it also runs the gate tests and the TLC registry as ten serial shard jobs, and accepts the shards only through check-formal.py --combine.
Documents that pull requests check applicability only and that release tags run the ten TLC shards and the combine check.
Documents the release-only TLC run, the case-position shards and the combined evidence.
Updates the execution budget for the applicability-only pull request job and the release shard jobs.

Adds case-position shards to run_suite and combine_shards, which accepts shard evidence only as one full merge-gate run of the same head, and reuses applied mutants within one process. Model bounds, mutants, deadlines and TLC options are unchanged.
Covers invalid shards and every combine refusal, and adds an optional worker-process runner that requires every test to run and pass.
Fails if TLC or the gate tests run on pull requests, if the applicability check becomes conditional, or if the combine step runs outside release mode.
Pins the sharded Formal validation command that follows the TLC download.
